decision: Locked before reading the reserved carrier. Do not refit after the holdout. Ship the candidate in free text only if neither direction of lax/tense confusion increases on the held-out acoustic proxy and detection/word discrimination does not collapse. Keep the archived preset available for reproduction. Human identification, timbre similarity and intonation preference require separate listening.
interventions: Close the initial lips before breath pressure rises
Short low transition after voiced intervocalic labial; adjust post-release pitch of aspirated and pressed quality of tense labials
Use three conservative /ʌ/ gestures estimated from recorded vowel formants
Compress only the tails of the last two vowels of a question with at least three vowel nuclei; evaluate speaker-specific ending shape
